verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm Insomnia supports HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSocket requests, with gRPC protobuf upload and GraphQL autocompletion/linting as concrete features (insomnia-docs-15, insomnia-docs-7, insomnia-docs-27, insomnia-docs-26). Missing for 10: explicit SSE request/streaming documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-protocol usage beyond vendor docs.
